title: Apply for a complying development certificate
summary: Apply online for a complying development certificate (CDC) for straightforward building developments.
intro:
Complying development is a fast-tracked application process for straightforward building developments.

If your proposed residential, commercial or industrial development is eligible you can apply online for a complying development certificate (CDC).
who_can_apply: Proposed residential, commercial, or industrial development that is eligible for complying development.
what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account or NSW Planning Portal login details.
Payment for NSW Planning Portal service fees.
A comprehensive list of required documents (refer to the Complying development application document checklist – PDF).

how_to_steps.text: Select ‘Log in with a Service NSW account’ or enter your NSW Planning Portal login details.
Follow the prompts to complete your application.
your application will be sent to your nominated certifier for consideration
the certifier will conduct a pre-assessment review and advise if any additional or revised documents are required
a fee quote will be issued for your review.

contact: For more information about the NSW Planning Portal and development applications, contact the Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure.

faqs.a: Complying development is a fast-tracked application process for straightforward building developments.

faqs.q: How do I start the application process?
faqs.a: Select the 'Apply online' button and log in with a Service NSW account or your NSW Planning Portal login details.

faqs.q: What types of developments qualify for complying development?
faqs.a: Examples include new houses up to 2 storeys, renovating an existing house, diverse housing types, new swimming pools, new fences, change of use, alterations, and construction of a new building.
